vision: We build AI-powered wearable systems to understand human health and behavior in everyday life. Our work spans machine learning methods and low-cost sensing prototypes that transform raw signals into meaningful insights, helping people improve their daily lives.

thrusts.title: AI for Wearables
thrusts.summary: We develop efficient AI algorithms to turn multimodal wearables streams to reliable human-centered insights.

thrusts.title: New Sensing Capacity
thrusts.summary: We unlock new sensing capabilities that open a fresh lens into human states.
